CHECK: NOW COVERAGE ONLY.
Every explicit action, result, and named participant in NOW must happen in CANDIDATE. A state merely described as already complete does not count as performing the assigned action.

NOW
Nia enters the shelter and locks the shelter door.

CANDIDATE
